# Data model

PostgreSQL schema owned by Flyway (`managio_backend/src/main/resources/db/migration`). Hibernate validates against it and never changes it. The schema starts at `V1__initial_schema.sql` (D-021); later changes are new migrations, never edits to applied ones.

Status: `[VERIFIED]` 2026-10-20 that `V1__initial_schema.sql` builds all 26 tables on PostgreSQL 17 (`MigrationTest`). Each table's use by the application is verified as its module is built (see STATUS.md).

## Conventions

* Primary keys: `bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY`.
* Every tenant table has `business_id` with `ON DELETE CASCADE` to `businesses`; every query filters by it.
* Timestamps: `timestamptz`. Business dates (`starts_on`, `due_on`, `spent_on`, `paid_on`, `business_date`): `date` in the business time zone.
* Money: `numeric(12,2)`.
* Mutable aggregates carry `version` for optimistic locking.
* Index names: `ux_` unique, `ix_` other, `ck_` check constraints.
* Nothing is hard-deleted that has money or history attached: customers are archived, invoices, payments and expenses are voided.

## Tables

### Identity
| Table | Purpose and invariants |
|---|---|
| `users` | Owners and staff (D-006). Email unique case-insensitively. `password_hash` null for Google-only accounts. `google_subject` unique. `status` ACTIVE or DISABLED. |
| `refresh_tokens` | Hashed refresh tokens for users and customers (`subject_type`), grouped in rotation families. |
| `one_time_tokens` | Hashed single-use tokens: `EMAIL_VERIFICATION`, `PASSWORD_RESET`, `PORTAL_INVITATION` (7 days), for users or customers. |
| `sign_in_events` | Sign-in attempts and outcomes for security review. |

### Businesses and team
| Table | Purpose and invariants |
|---|---|
| `businesses` | A business. `code` four digits + four letters, unique, never changes. `type` one of FITNESS, SALON, COACHING, SCHOOL, CLINIC, RETAIL, OTHER. `modules` lists enabled optional modules. Invoice and receipt prefixes, time zone, currency, GSTIN. `allow_customer_signup` opens portal self sign-up; `renewal_reminders` (default true) turns the daily reminder email on or off. |
| `business_sequences` | Next number per business for `CUSTOMER`, `INVOICE`, `RECEIPT`. Rows are locked when a number is taken (D-014). |
| `roles` | Per-business roles; `permissions` is a text array of permission keys; `system_key` identifies seeded roles (OWNER, MANAGER, …). Name unique per business. |
| `team_members` | A user's membership in a business: role, status (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, LEFT), title, salary. One row per user per business. The owner is a team member with the OWNER role. |
| `invitations` | Pending invitations: email, role, hashed token, expiry, accepted or revoked. |

### Customers
| Table | Purpose and invariants |
|---|---|
| `customers` | People the business serves. `number` unique per business. `status` ACTIVE or ARCHIVED. Portal credentials live here; email and phone are unique among portal-enabled customers in a business. |
| `customer_groups`, `customer_group_members` | Batches, classes or other groupings. |
| `attendance` | One check-in per customer per date. |

### Offerings and memberships
| Table | Purpose and invariants |
|---|---|
| `offerings` | What the business sells: `PLAN` (needs duration value and unit DAYS or MONTHS, optional installments 1–24), `SERVICE`, `PRODUCT` (optional stock tracking). Price ≥ 0, tax rate 0–100. |
| `memberships` | A customer's plan from `starts_on` to `ends_on` (inclusive). `status` ACTIVE or CANCELLED; expiry is derived from dates (D-012). `renewed_from_id` links renewals. `reminder_sent_at` marks that the renewal reminder email went out. |

### Billing
| Table | Purpose and invariants |
|---|---|
| `invoices` | What is owed. `number` unique per business. Optional `customer_id` (walk-in sales) and `membership_id` (installments). `status` ISSUED or VOID; paid/due/overdue is derived from payments and dates. `discount ≤ subtotal`. |
| `invoice_lines` | Line items with quantity, unit price, tax rate and amount. |
| `payments` | Money received (`PAYMENT`) or returned (`REFUND`), always against an invoice. `number` is the receipt number, unique per business. Amount > 0. A refund links to the payment it returns (`refund_of_id`), and only refunds have that link. Method CASH, UPI, CARD, BANK_TRANSFER, CHEQUE, ONLINE, OTHER. Voided, never deleted. |

| `idempotency_keys` | One row per `Idempotency-Key` used on a money action (D-033): business, user, key (unique together), operation, SHA-256 of the request and the stored response. Rows older than 7 days are deleted nightly. |

### Expenses and payroll
| Table | Purpose and invariants |
|---|---|
| `expense_categories` | Per-business categories; seeded ones carry a `system_key` (SALARIES is used by payroll). |
| `expenses` | Money spent. Amount > 0. Optional links to a payroll entry or the request that created it. Voided, never deleted. |
| `payroll_entries` | Salary owed to a team member for a month (`period` is the first day of the month). One per member per month. Paid amount is the sum of linked expenses. |

### Operations
| Table | Purpose and invariants |
|---|---|
| `tasks` | Title, status (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, CANCELLED), priority, due date, assignee, optional customer, repeat rule. |
| `requests` | Expense claims, purchases, leave, discounts and other requests with status PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED or CANCELLED, requester, decider and note. |
| `day_closes` | One cash count per business date with opening, cash in, cash out, expected, counted and difference. |
| `notifications` | In-app notifications per user. |
| `activity_events` | Who did what in a business, with a readable summary. |

## History

v1 used migrations V1–V16 with a different schema. The owner chose to start fresh with no data carried over (D-021), so those migrations were deleted. A database that still has v1 history in `flyway_schema_history` must be reset before the API can start against it.

## Migrations `[VERIFIED]` (MigrationTest, AdminTest)

| Version | What it does |
|---|---|
| `V1__initial_schema.sql` | The v2 schema (D-021). |
| `V2__platform_console_indexes.sql` | Indexes `activity_events (created_at)` and `refresh_tokens (subject_type, created_at)` for the platform console's time-window counts across all businesses (D-028). Indexes only; no data changes. Applied to the local development database on 2026-10-21 with its data intact. |
| `V3__idempotency_keys.sql` | Adds the `idempotency_keys` table (D-033). New table only; no data changes. Applied to the local development database on 2026-10-22 with its data intact, and on an empty database by MigrationTest. |

New schema changes are new migrations that carry existing data forward; applied migrations are never edited.
